CorrelationId.description: Optional trace ID; generated if absent and returned on every response
CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id

inputSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact file assessed

reserve.description: Initial reserve; above your authority limit it waits for approval

committed.description: Committed to payments awaiting approval or issuing

contactName.description: Defaults to the claimant's name; required when staff report for someone

description.example: Rear-ended at a traffic signal; bumper and tail lamp damaged

authorityLimit.description: Largest reserve or payment the user may approve alone

fields.description: Corrected values; allowed keys: docType, totalAmount, currency, issueDate, severity, costLow, costHigh

PortalClaimResponse.description: A claim as its claimant sees it: no fraud score, segment, flags or internal notes

PortalCompletion.description: duplicate = true: this exact file was already on the claim; 'document' is that one

ReserveResponse.description: pendingApproval is set when the change is above your authority and waits for a supervisor

version.description: Also sent as the ETag header; send it back in If-Match

text.description: Reason for an event, or the note text

refreshToken.description: Single-use: every refresh returns a new one and revokes the old one

UploadInstructions.description: PUT the file to uploadUrl with these headers before it expires, then call complete

sizeBytes.description: Exact size in bytes; at most 10 MB

info.description:
Guidewire-style claims handling: FNOL, exposures, reserves, payments, approvals, SIU and AI document assessment.

API version **v1** (contract 1.5.0). Breaking changes get `/api/v2`; additions bump the minor version.
